index.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
index.scale: 0-100 weighted average; AA leaderboards display integer-rounded values

Last archived capture labelled v4.3.2 is 2026-10-28T01:03:49Z; first labelled v5.0 is 2026-10-29T01:01:15Z; latest labelled v5.0 used here is 2026-11-03T19:33:41Z.
changes_from_v4_3_2: CritPt replaced by CritPt v2 (Hard Subset) at 10%
Removed GDPval-AA, SciCode, AA-LCR and Humanity's Last Exam
Category weights rebalanced to Knowledge Work, Coding, Science and General at 25% each

v5.0.1.effective: AA changelog dates the v5.0.1 methodology update 2026-11-03; the latest v5.0-labelled capture (2026-11-03T19:33:41Z) shows rollout after that time. Observed live on 2026-11-06.
changes_from_v5_0: CritPt v2 regraded for all models with grading-robustness improvements from the CritPt authors; weights and components unchanged

components.scoring: Combined Elo; index uses clamp((Elo - 500) / 2000) on the Elo frozen at model addition
Objective completion; zero credit on guardrail violation
Tests plus LLM-judge rubric; any blocking check scores zero
Official grading server, pass@1, 40 problems x 5; regraded in v5.0.1

index.composite_rule: Index = 100 x sum(weight x normalized component). AA does not publish a composite for a variant missing any component.
index.testing_parameters: Temperature 0 for non-reasoning and 0.6 for reasoning models unless the lab recommends otherwise; reasoning models use the creator-disclosed maximum output tokens; pass@1 scoring; effort variants are separate entries.

verification.v5_0_to_v5_0_1_delta: For every variant observed in both versions, index(v5.0.1) - index(v5.0) equals 10 x (CritPt v2 Hard score change) to rounding, consistent with the documented CritPt-only regrade.
verification.reconstruction: Recomputing each published v5.0.1 index from the ten component values, documented weights and Briefcase normalization reproduces it within 0.173 points. The residual is consistent with AA using the Briefcase Elo frozen at model addition while pages display the current Elo; the frozen Elo is not published.
verification.archived_consistency: Across 19 archived model-page captures (2026-10-29T02:51:14Z to 2026-11-03T19:33:41Z) and 4 leaderboard captures (2026-10-29T01:01:15Z to 2026-11-01T01:04:03Z) labelled v5.0, no target variant record shows two different non-null values under the same AA record name. The only slug carrying two record names is mistral-large-4 (Mistral Large 4 Preview, then Mistral Large 4 (High)); see that release's aa_slug_history. glm-5-3-flash, kimi-k3-low, qwen3-8-27b-low and qwen3-8-27b-medium were null in captures up to 2026-10-29T14:59:06Z and published from 2026-10-30T00:20:19Z; qwen3-8-27b-non-reasoning first appears with a value at 2026-11-01T18:03:13Z.
verification.release_level_objects: The glm-5-3 release-page capture embeds a release-level summary object for Claude Fable 5.1 (modelCount 5) whose intelligenceIndex 50.022 equals the Xhigh variant, not the Max variant (49.160). No captured page embeds a Kimi K3 release-level object carrying an index; the deprecated Kimi K3 release object has only slug, name, deprecation and release date. The Kimi K3 highest_published_variant (Low, 17.419) is computed here as the maximum over published variants; it is not an AA-published release figure.
verification.homepage_crosscheck: The AA homepage capture (2026-11-06T08:09:37Z) embeds v5.0.1 records for 11 of the target variants (kimi-k3-1-pro, glm-5-3, deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017, qwen3-8-27b, mistral-large-4, claude-opus-5-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-sonnet-5-5, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-1-sol, gemini-4-carbon); all equal the values recorded here. Its full model dataset is delivered as encrypted manifests and was not used.
verification.independent_corroboration: None available. No pinned publisher card in this atlas quotes an AA Intelligence Index value; AA is the only primary source for these composites.

applicability: Scores describe AA runs of each lab or provider endpoint at the stated effort setting. They do not identify the catalog revision, the NVFP4/MXFP4/FP8 export, the engine, KServe path or B300 node.
A quantized export or different chat-template, reasoning-budget or tool-call configuration requires its own quality evaluation; the AA composite does not transfer to it.

Effort variants differ substantially (for example Claude Opus 5.5 Low 34.75 versus Max 59.11 in v5.0.1). Compare like-for-like effort settings and report token use and cost per task alongside the index.
Null composites mean incomplete AA coverage, not a zero score. Do not substitute a neighbouring variant, successor release or older index version.
